segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: *Histogram specification* is an image-processing operation that calculates the histogram of a reference image and applies it to an input image.
segments.ko: *Histogram specification* is an image-processing operation that calculates the histogram of a reference image and applies it to an input image.

segments.source: The operation changes the colors and tones of the input image to match those of the reference image.
segments.ko: The operation changes the colors and tones of the input image to match those of the reference image.

segments.source: Perform Histogram Specification Using Pixel Buffers
segments.ko: Perform Histogram Specification Using Pixel Buffers

segments.source: The [`vImage.PixelBuffer`](vimage/pixelbuffer.md) structure provides a simple API to calculate and specify a histogram.
segments.ko: The [`vImage.PixelBuffer`](vimage/pixelbuffer.md) structure provides a simple API to calculate and specify a histogram.

segments.source: The [`histogram()`](vimage/pixelbuffer/histogram()-30tsp.md) function returns the histogram of a pixel buffer, and the [`specifyHistogram(_:destination:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/specifyhistogram(_:destination:)-qeqr.md) function performs the histogram specification operation.
segments.ko: The [`histogram()`](vimage/pixelbuffer/histogram()-30tsp.md) function returns the histogram of a pixel buffer, and the [`specifyHistogram(_:destination:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/specifyhistogram(_:destination:)-qeqr.md) function performs the histogram specification operation.

segments.source: If you’re creating apps for older operating systems that don’t support the [`vImage.PixelBuffer`](vimage/pixelbuffer.md) API, the sample code project also includes source code for performing histogram specification using [`vImage_Buffer`](vimage_buffer.md) structures.
segments.ko: If you’re creating apps for older operating systems that don’t support the [`vImage.PixelBuffer`](vimage/pixelbuffer.md) API, the sample code project also includes source code for performing histogram specification using [`vImage_Buffer`](vimage_buffer.md) structures.

segments.source: The [`vImageHistogramCalculation_ARGB8888(_:_:_:)`](vimagehistogramcalculation_argb8888(_:_:_:).md) calculates and stores histogram data in four arrays — one for each channel — where the value of each element is the number of pixels in the reference image with that color value.
segments.ko: The [`vImageHistogramCalculation_ARGB8888(_:_:_:)`](vimagehistogramcalculation_argb8888(_:_:_:).md) calculates and stores histogram data in four arrays — one for each channel — where the value of each element is the number of pixels in the reference image with that color value.

segments.source: In an 8-bit-per-channel image, each color channel can hold 256 different values, and the sample code defines each array with a count of 256.
segments.ko: In an 8-bit-per-channel image, each color channel can hold 256 different values, and the sample code defines each array with a count of 256.
